players.product: Apple Silicon (A19 / A19 Pro, M5) — leading-edge logic on TSMC N2/N3

quarterly_data.signal: Apple announced the next generation of Apple TV 4K (4th generation) on October 13, 2026. Its A19 chip 'delivers up to 50 percent faster CPU performance and up to 2x faster GPU performance than the previous generation' and includes a new, dedicated AV1 decoder; the device adds three far-field microphones for hands-free Siri and brings Siri AI (beta), with Siri requests using on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute. Pre-orders started October 13 in the U.S. and 29 other countries and regions, with availability in stores beginning November 13, at $299 (U.S.). Bob Borchers, Apple's vice president of Worldwide Product Marketing: 'The new Apple TV 4K is our most immersive home theater experience yet.'
